description: This header file defines the class `HDCPDetailedInfo` within the `WPEFramework::Plugin` namespace. The class encapsulates a string representing HDCP detailed information, providing constructors, a destructor, and accessor methods for the data and length. It also explicitly deletes copy and assignment constructors to prevent copying.

classes.name: HDCPDetailedInfo
classes.description: A class that stores HDCP detailed information as a string, with methods to access its data and length, and constructors to initialize the data.

methods.name: HDCPDetailedInfo(const TCHAR formatter[], ...)
methods.description: Constructor that formats a string with variable arguments into the internal `_text` member.

methods.name: HDCPDetailedInfo(const string& text)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes `_text` with the given string.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a const pointer to the internal C-string data.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the stored string as a uint16_t.
